title: Preallocate DML HNSW index names
description: Replace DML-side format!("hnsw_{}_{}", table, column) construction with a shared exact-capacity Executor helper.

criteria: Generated HNSW index name remains hnsw_<table>_<column>
Insert, upsert, update, and delete DML regression tests pass

notes: The helper uses String::with_capacity with the exact literal and separator lengths.
DML insert, upsert-update, update, and delete HNSW paths now share the helper.
Remaining HNSW name construction call sites are outside DML and stay queued for later iterations.
